channel.title: Wire — Ruby
channel.description: Ruby from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Do Agents Really Do Better With TypeScript?
item.description: Type errors took under 1% of our coding agents' time. In three public benchmarks, TypeScript fixes scored no higher than plain JavaScript ones, and adding Sorbet or RBS to a Rails app left the solve rate unchanged. (2 sources: nodeweekly, rubyweekly)

item.title: Content-Addressable Gems: The New Way of Packaging Precompiled Binaries
item.description: RubyGems 4.1 introduces content-addressable gems: precompiled gems built for a single Ruby ABI, which makes them smaller and lets maintainers support new Rubies without a new release. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: RubyGems and Bundler 4.1.1
item.description: RubyGems and Bundler 4.1.1 include enhancements, bug fixes and documentation. (1 source: rubyweekly)
